title: 5 Best SEO Tools for Agencies in 2026

claims.finding: Semrush's official website and multiple third-party sources confirm the platform offers 55 tools as of 2026, matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: Position Tracking supports up to 20,000 keywords
claims.finding: According to Semrush's official documentation, Position Tracking supports up to 5,000 keywords on the Business plan, not 20,000. The keyword limits are: Pro (500), Guru (1,500), and Business (5,000).
Current official Semrush documentation and multiple sources show the Pro plan at $139.95 per month for monthly billing, not $129.95 as claimed in the statement.
Multiple current sources from 2026, including one citing Semrush's official pricing page from April 2026, confirm that the Pro plan includes 5 projects.
The Guru plan costs $249.95/month when billed monthly, as stated in Semrush's official documentation and confirmed across multiple current sources from 2026.
Semrush's official help documentation confirms that the Guru plan includes 15 projects, matching the claim exactly.
Semrush's Business plan costs $499.95 per month when billed monthly, as confirmed by official Semrush knowledge base pages and their pricing documentation across multiple regional sites.
Semrush's official pricing page confirms the Advanced plan (formerly Business) includes 40 websites to monitor, which corresponds to 40 projects as stated in the claim.

claims.claim_text: Annual billing provides two months free
claims.finding: Semrush's official documentation states annual billing saves around 17% across their plans, which is mathematically equivalent to approximately two months free (16.67%). The claim accurately represents the annual billing discount.

claims.claim_text: Updates its index with 8 billion pages daily
claims.finding: Ahrefs official documentation confirms their crawler visits 8 billion web pages every 24 hours, which matches the claim exactly.

claims.claim_text: Has 36 trillion backlinks in the index
claims.finding: Ahrefs' official pages currently report 35 trillion external backlinks in their index, not 36 trillion as claimed.

claims.claim_text: Site Audit can crawl up to 500,000 pages
claims.finding: According to Ahrefs' current official pricing page and documentation, the Standard plan provides 500,000 crawl credits per month (not a per-crawl limit of 500,000 pages). The claim conflates monthly crawl credit allocation with per-crawl page limits, which are separate settings in Site Audit.

claims.claim_text: Keywords Explorer has 171 million keyword database across 10 search engines
claims.finding: Ahrefs currently reports 28.7 billion keywords across 217 locations, not 171 million keywords across 10 search engines. The claim appears to be severely outdated or confused with other metrics.
The Lite plan currently costs $129/month, not $99/month. Ahrefs increased prices in April 2024, raising the Lite plan from $99 to $129 per month.
According to Ahrefs' official documentation and pricing page, the Lite plan does include 5 projects, along with 750 tracked keywords and other features.

The current Ahrefs Standard plan costs $249/month according to official sources, not $199/month. Ahrefs' own help documentation confirms that $199 was the legacy Standard plan price before it increased to $249.
The Ahrefs Standard plan currently includes 20 unverified projects according to official Ahrefs help documentation and multiple third-party sources verified against ahrefs.com in 2026.
The Advanced plan costs $449/month when billed monthly, not $399/month. The $399/month price only applies to annual billing commitments.
The Advanced plan currently includes 50 projects according to Ahrefs' official pricing page at $449 per month.

Current sources from 2026 consistently report the Ahrefs Enterprise plan costs $1,499 per month, not $999 per month. The $999 figure appears in one source as part of a range ($999-$1,499) but the actual starting Enterprise price is $1,499.
The Enterprise plan includes 100 unverified projects and unlimited verified projects, not unlimited projects outright. Verified projects require ownership verification through Ahrefs's process.
